create_EmpDataset: create an EmpDataset from a CSV split file with dictionary, max length, and history length parameters
run_txt2vec: run txt2vec to convert text to token IDs using a BERT tokenizer or ParlAI dictionary
run_sentence_to_tensor: run sentence_to_tensor to convert a sentence string into a PyTorch LongTensor with optional max length
get_EmpDataset_item: get a data item by index from an EmpDataset instance returning context, label, and emotion tensor
get_EmpDataset_id: get the topic and utterance ID tuple for a given index in the EmpDataset
